description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeContactDetailsAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It includes tests for retrieving single contact details and updating them, as well as placeholder tests for create, delete, and validation rule methods which are not implemented. The tests use a custom test framework extending EndpointIntegrationTestCase and make use of mock services and fixtures.

classes.name: EmployeeContactDetailsAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeContactDetailsAPI endpoints, including retrieval, update, and unimplemented create/delete actions.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a single employee contact detail using the API.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an employee contact detail via the API.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Ensures that the create method throws a not-implemented exception.

methods.description: Ensures that the validation rules for create are not implemented.
